disable.label: Disable
disable.consequence: Blocks sign-in to this workspace and ends their sessions here.
disable.confirmBody: They lose access to this workspace at once. Their roles and history stay, and you can enable them again.

enable.label: Enable
enable.consequence: Lets them sign in to this workspace again.
enable.confirmBody: They can sign in again with the roles they had.

revokeSessions.label: Revoke sessions
revokeSessions.consequence: Signs them out on every device. Role changes apply at once.
revokeSessions.confirmBody: Every session ends now. They can sign in again.

remove.label: Remove from workspace
remove.consequence: Takes away membership and roles here. The account stays.
remove.confirmBody: They lose access immediately and their roles here are removed. Their account and audit history stay.
